name: custos_meter
comment: The governor's meter (charter 8.3, TPS 5.3.31): one row per governed request, written at GA9 (anonymous reads sampled 1 in $wgCustosMeterSample); the budget job rolls the rows up into custos_budget.

columns.name: cm_time
columns.comment: The server time the request started, whole seconds

columns.name: cm_account
columns.comment: The account's user name; empty for an anonymous request

columns.name: cm_network
columns.comment: The anonymous request's network; empty for an account's

columns.name: cm_op
columns.comment: The governed request's kind, the Calculator's word

columns.name: cm_lane
columns.comment: The kind's lane number (custos/lanes.json, pcalc governor lane)

columns.name: cm_cpu
columns.comment: CPU time, thousandths of a CPU second

columns.name: cm_wall
columns.comment: Wall time, thousandths of a second

columns.name: cm_weight
columns.comment: The rows this row stands for: the sample's 1 in N, else 1
